All claims remain source_declared; no data ingestion, data download, licence review, build, tests, WebAssembly compilation, WebGL execution, network operation or deployment observation was performed.
DEMO.md reserve counts, EROI thresholds, depletion rates, emission factors, social cost of carbon, grid stress, P2P trading, breakeven prices and transition narrative are not independently validated.
The data-layer counts have no item-level source file, version, digest or rights manifest in this bounded projection.
The live URL statement was not health-checked or tied to the pinned source revision.
Bevy/Symtropy and Holochain/Mycelix integration claims are source-declared only; no exact contract/version or runtime receipt was inspected.
51 shared core tests are a demo-reported count, not an exact-head test pass.

Expanded projection adds decision-reliance, TUF freshness, earth-observability, static/Holochain data paths and reactor-twin disclaimer sources. It remains a source projection; no evaluator, schema, TUF, sensor, Holochain or simulation code was executed.
Decision-reliance documentation states its evaluator and schemas are implemented but exact-head Rust/schema/executable-fixture qualification is pending; do not promote it to qualified.
The TUF freshness module is explicitly a consumer-side adapter and not a TUF client or signature verifier.

The Earth-observability bridge is explicitly a protocol with adapter and physical likelihood qualification not implemented; POD and PFA, sensor dependence and prevalence remain separate statistical concerns.
The reactor-twin demo explicitly replays a static recorded FissionTwin run, labels its capstone tick synthetic, and separates this simulation from real named operating plants.
Cross-project ownership statements do not verify compatibility, physical calibration, decision correctness, authority, rights or custody.
